$comment: Fingerprints of every sample in test-output/. Regenerate deliberately with `npx tsx scripts/verify-samples.ts --update`, and say why in the release notes: a changed hash means existing output changed. Mode `bytes` is a SHA-256 of the file; mode `semantic` is a SHA-256 of a canonical projection of the decrypted document, used for encrypted samples whose bytes are CSPRNG-derived and can never repeat. Each entry's `since` names the release whose output the hash is: it is carried forward untouched while the sample is unchanged, and moves to the release doing the rebaseline when the hash changes, so the chain 1.7.0 -> 1.8.0 -> 1.9.0 stays auditable and every re-anchoring is visible in the diff.
provenance: The 1.7.0 entries were verified against a v1.7.0 git worktree carrying only the determinism plumbing (pinned creation instant, TZ=UTC). Entries stamped 1.8.0 are, in order: the 29 samples introduced by 1.8.0; the nine whose v1.7.0 output was non-deterministic by construction (a Math.random() fixture, an unpinned incremental /ModDate, seven signature samples whose /M and CMS signingTime defaulted to the wall clock); and the samples whose output 1.8.0 changed deliberately — Khmer, Myanmar, Lao, Tai Tham, New Tai Lue, Tai Le and Cham shaping, COLRv1 emoji (transforms, then the alpha-ramp layers), regenerated font modules, the no-break-space metric fix (three compression samples), the base-14 measurement fix (text-extract-report, table-micro-columns), the no-break-space glyph fix (four pdfa-latin samples), the English-only pass over sample prose (digital-signature-info, then the three typography samples that demonstrated hyphenation on French words), the 27 alphabet plates (column widths and neutral labels), the four printer's-marks samples (clearance and colour bars) and every sample embedding a TrueType face whose source carries hinting tables (prep, fpgm, cvt, gasp are now kept in the subset; outlines unchanged). The Indic and mark-positioning pass then re-anchored, in order: every sample set with a font module that carries GPOS mark anchors (the 29 regenerated modules keep one anchor class per subtable instead of collapsing them all to class 0, so above-base vowel signs, harakat, niqqud, tone marks and stacked marks land where the font designed them — alphabet, document, shaping, extreme, bidi, diverse, financial, compression, tagged, pdfa-latin, print, emoji, typography, math and tools samples that embed those faces); the five Indic scripts shaped by the OpenType engine (Tamil i-matra after its consonant, reph after the base, Telugu subjoined forms, per-feature conjuncts, one glyph for Devanagari o and au); the sixteen one-page language conformance documents whose content was rewritten around the script's edge cases (doc-thai, doc-bengali, doc-tamil, doc-devanagari, doc-telugu, doc-sinhala, doc-tibetan, doc-khmer, doc-myanmar, doc-amharic, doc-arabic, doc-hebrew, and the four new doc-hausa, doc-yoruba, doc-igbo, doc-swahili), then the thirteen documents that gave every remaining bundled script one (doc-lao, doc-taitham, doc-newtailue, doc-taile, doc-cham, doc-korean, doc-greek, doc-cyrillic, doc-georgian, doc-armenian, doc-turkish, doc-vietnamese, doc-polish); the four new Latin-script African alphabet plates; the ToUnicode CMap of every document whose shaper reports multi-code-point glyphs; and every sample embedding a TrueType subset, whose head.checkSumAdjustment is now computed instead of written as zero — this last change also moves the eight Greek, Polish, Turkish and Vietnamese samples that the hinting-table change had left at 1.7.0. The conformance-review pass then re-anchored: the Thai and Lao sara am ordering fix and the Lao pali virama advance (diverse-recipe-th, doc-thai, doc-lao, alphabet-lao), and the twenty samples embedding the Cyrillic, Greek, Polish, Turkish or Vietnamese modules, whose source subsets are now cut from the pinned NotoSans-VF.ttf by the library's own subsetTTF() instead of the historical pyftsubset files (same outlines; the Cyrillic face is the unhinted default instance with the variable font's glyph ids). Every re-anchoring is listed in the 1.8.0 release note. Counts: 1.7.0=114, 1.8.0=178.
